strategies.name: ict_mss_retrace_pd_array_entry
strategies.entry_summary: After establishing higher-timeframe bias, wait for a stop raid/liquidity sweep, then a market structure shift/displacement in the intended direction. Enter on the retrace into discount/premium or OTE, using a PD array in that zone such as a fair value gap, order block, breaker block, or blended conﬂ
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop beyond the relevant swing low/high or the PD array boundary (for example the order-block high/low). Take partials at opposing liquidity or prior highs/lows, optionally move stop to break even, and/or hold runners toward further liquidity targets.

strategies.name: box_setup_deviation_retest
strategies.entry_summary: Use a range/deviation box setup: after price deviates below the range and reclaims back into it, wait for a retest of the manipulation/deviation area and enter for a move to the opposite side of the range. The speaker explicitly notes this can be taken even without the prior lower-timeframe stop-rai
strategies.exit_summary: Take partials on the move higher and target the opposite-side liquidity above the range. The example implies managing around intermediate targets before the full reach to the highs.
